question: I have a question about Thriller Bark's super-super cute Perona! In the cover page serial that ran around the Skypiea arc, entitled "Wapol's Omnivorous Hurrah", he used his Baku Baku no Mi ability to create a toy called "KABASHINSHI" (Hippo Gentleman). Does this have anything to do with the Hippo Gentleman that answers to Perona? Is Perona a fan of Wapol's toys?
answer: I've got two questions here. Very well spotted, in both cases. First, the Kumashi plushie. He did not grow up to be that size. Perona simply likes having Hogback create zombies based on her plushies. She got Wapol's "KABASHINSHI" somewhere along the way, so it's quite likely that she had Hogback create his own version for her.
name: Mizuki
